resources.string: Opens the full policy in the browser
No browser found to open the privacy policy
Local: nothing leaves the phone, the model on the device answers.
Flash: the text of the request and the latest messages go to the OMNIX server and then to an AI provider (Google, Groq or OpenRouter).
Pro: the same, but the provider is Anthropic (Claude). Private requests go to the cloud only with your consent.
Speech: Turkmen and interpreter phrases are sent as short audio to the server and to Groq for recognition.
